scenarios.notes: Dodongo's Cavern main lobby via ENTR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_ENTRANCE (0x004). The scene ships gDCLavaFloor1Tex..8Tex as its lava floors; the classifier must claim them by volcanic token while torch flame billboards stay excluded.

King Dodongo boss arena via ENTR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_BOSS_ENTRANCE (0x40B). The floor alternates sLavaFloorLavaTex (melt) and sLavaFloorRockTex (cooled basalt plate); the classifier must split the pair into LAVA_SURFACE and VOLCANIC_HOT_ROCK rather than treating both as one orange sheet.

Death Mountain Crater exterior via ENTR_DEATH_MOUNTAIN_CRATER_UPPER_EXIT (0x147). Authentic outdoor volcanic scene: crater rock, smoke cone, and melt. Open-sky directional light plus thermal emission must coexist without a global orange light.

verifiedMappings.evidence: soh/include/tables/entrance_table.h defines ENTR_KOKIRI_FOREST_0 at 0x0EE for SCENE_KOKIRI_FOREST; the fork scene table maps Kokiri Forest to 0x55 and entrance room is 0.
entrance_table.h: ENTR_LAKE_HYLIA_NORTH_EXIT at 0x102, SCENE_LAKE_HYLIA, spawn 0. scene_table.h maps SCENE_LAKE_HYLIA to 0x57.

entrance_table.h: ENTR_TEMPLE_OF_TIME_ENTRANCE 0x053, scene_table.h: SCENE_TEMPLE_OF_TIME 0x43. Spawn index 0 is not the room index. Runtime SCENE_READY log in 20261014_112821_098_TEMPLE_INTERIOR_NORMAL records room 1 twice.
entrance_table.h: 0x0CD defines ENTR_HYRULE_FIELD_PAST_BRIDGE_SPAWN, SCENE_HYRULE_FIELD, spawn 0. scene_table.h maps SCENE_HYRULE_FIELD to 0x51. Actual room is a runtime gate.

entrance_table.h: ENTR_GORON_CITY_DARUNIA_ROOM_EXIT 0x1C1, scene_table.h: SCENE_GORON_CITY 0x62, spawn 1 loads room 1. spot18_room_1 contains two authentic lit Obj_Syokudai torches at (-52, 40, -1473) and (222, 40, -1473).
entrance_table.h: ENTR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_ENTRANCE at 0x004 maps to SCENE_DODONGOS_CAVERN; scene_table.h maps ddan_scene to 0x01.

entrance_table.h: ENTR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_BOSS_ENTRANCE at 0x40B maps to SCENE_DODONGOS_CAVERN_BOSS; scene_table.h maps ddan_boss_scene to 0x12. Runtime SCENE_READY log in 20261016_183810_706_KING_DODONGO_LAVA_ARENA_NORMAL records room 1, so room 1 is the arena, not the spawn index 0.
entrance_table.h: ENTR_DEATH_MOUNTAIN_CRATER_UPPER_EXIT at 0x147 maps to SCENE_DEATH_MOUNTAIN_CRATER; scene_table.h maps spot17_scene to 0x61.

views.notes: Diagnostic candidate in scene coordinates; visible water must be checked in the actual capture before accepting water evidence.
